تعتصرون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِرُونَ (taʕtaṣirūna) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# تُعْتَصَرُونَ (tuʕtaṣarūna) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
